biography.title: Early Life in Vadnagar
biography.description: Born on September 17, 1950, in Vadnagar, Gujarat, to Damodardas Mulchand Modi and Hiraba Modi. Helped his father at their tea stall at the Vadnagar railway station.

biography.title: Spiritual Journey
biography.description: Left home to travel across India, visiting various ashrams and seeking spiritual and personal growth.

biography.title: Joining the RSS
biography.description: Officially became a full-time pracharak in the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). Actively participated in the 1974 Navnirman movement and during the Emergency (1975–1977).

biography.title: Higher Education
biography.description: Completed his Master of Arts in Political Science from Gujarat University.

biography.title: Entry into the BJP
biography.description: Transitioned to mainstream politics by joining the Bharatiya Janata Party. Quickly rose to become the General Secretary of the BJP's Gujarat unit.

politicalJourney.title: Chief Minister of Gujarat
politicalJourney.description: Sworn in as the Chief Minister of Gujarat. His tenure focused on strengthening infrastructure and the state economy. This period included the 2002 Gujarat riots, after which a Supreme Court-appointed SIT cleared him of complicity.

politicalJourney.title: 14th Prime Minister of India
politicalJourney.description: Elected as the Prime Minister of India with a historic mandate, beginning his first term with a focus on financial inclusion and infrastructure.

politicalJourney.title: Re-election to Second Term
politicalJourney.description: Returned to power with an even larger majority. Focus expanded to sweeping welfare programs, digitalization, and global standing.

politicalJourney.title: Historic Third Term
politicalJourney.description: Secured a third consecutive term as Prime Minister, focusing on the vision of a 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India) by 2047.

achievements.headline: Financial Inclusion
achievements.description: Over 58 crore bank accounts opened under PMJDY, bringing the unbanked into the formal financial system.

achievements.headline: Universal Health Coverage
achievements.description: Ayushman Bharat provides ₹5 lakh health coverage, recently expanded to all senior citizens aged 70 and above.

achievements.headline: Digital Public Infrastructure
achievements.description: The JAM Trinity (Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile) ensures transparent direct benefit transfers, powering the massive success of UPI.

achievements.headline: PM GatiShakti & Connectivity
achievements.description: Massive modernization of railways with Vande Bharat and expansive highway network development.

upcomingProjects.title: Shakti Ki Sapt Dhara
upcomingProjects.description: A seven-pillar reform framework driving growth in manufacturing, tech, connectivity, and defence.

upcomingProjects.title: National AI Skilling
upcomingProjects.description: Initiative to train one crore youth in Artificial Intelligence over the next year.

upcomingProjects.title: Semiconductor Mission
upcomingProjects.description: Development of 7-8 new semiconductor manufacturing facilities becoming operational soon.

upcomingProjects.title: Mumbai–Ahmedabad HSR
upcomingProjects.description: Construction of India's first high-speed rail corridor.
